items.title: The locus of points over which a flat finitely presented module is pure along the fibre is open
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the set of points of the base over which a finitely presented module flat over the base is pure along the fibre is open (statement lines 5489-5498, tag 05MC). The proof is a real etale local argument: it builds the affine etale neighbourhood with projective global sections, observes that the pulled back module is universally pure, uses the purity criterion and the constructibility of the relative assassin condition to produce a constructible set containing the spectrum of the local ring at the lifted point, and then converts that into an open neighbourhood whose image in the base is the required open set. The constructibility step is the substance, so the claim is H2.
